en.text:
Passively increases Sprint Speed by 6.25% and Slide Distance by 33%.

Sprinting for 1.5 seconds grants 'Linear Actuators' for 7 seconds. Melee or Glaive Hits with Linear Actuators active apply the 'Shocked' debuff to the target.

Shocked enemies chain <pve 220 /> <pvp [50] /> <arc/>Arc Damage to targets within 12 meters and spread the 'Shocked' debuff. Each chain grants two stacks of <arc/> Bolt Charge per instance.

Shocked lasts 2 seconds and its duration is refreshed when it chains to other targets. Shocked Players are immune to further chains for 2 seconds.
